tools.name: draw_cards
tools.description: Shuffles a 78-card Rider–Waite–Smith deck with a cryptographic random generator and deals a spread. Returns each position with the card, its orientation, the meaning for that orientation and a link that shows the spread with card pictures.

tools.name: draw_clarifier
tools.description: Draws one or more clarifying cards from the rest of the deck, leaving out the cards given in exclude.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Meaning of one tarot card, upright and reversed, with its element and a short description of the image. Accepts a card name in English or Lithuanian, or an id 0–77.

tools.name: list_spreads
tools.description: The available spreads with their number of cards and the meaning of each position.
